config.label: Apier API key in the form: Bearer <api_key>
config.description: Apier API key in the form: Bearer <api_key>. REQUIRED for company-data, authority, and action tools; OPTIONAL for the six keyless public tools: the five public reads (get_public_obligations, get_public_deadlines, explain_compliance_error, get_exchange_rate, get_pricing) answer with no credential at all, and redeem_issuance_token needs no API key but requires a one-time owner-issued issuance token in its arguments. All keyless calls are per-IP rate-limited. Provision a free key at https://www.apier.no/docs/authentication
